title: Open full-size photos on IMDb
question: How do I see an IMDb photo at full resolution?
answer: IMDb's photo viewer loads the original image but scales it to the window and covers it with a swipe layer, so right-click "Open image in new tab" does not work. The usermods script on this page adds a "Full size" button to the viewer that opens the original file in a new tab and follows along as you page through the gallery. Without an extension, copy an image address from m.media-amazon.com and delete everything between "._V1_" and ".jpg".
prompt: Add a button to IMDb's photo viewer that opens the current photo at full size in a new tab.
details: IMDb image addresses end in resize and crop instructions after `._V1_`, for example `._V1_QL75_UX190_CR0,2,190,281_.jpg`. The original upload is the same address ending in `._V1_.jpg`. The script reads the image the viewer is showing, builds that address and puts it on a yellow button in the viewer's top bar, next to Home. It only appears in the photo viewer (`/mediaviewer/` pages). Thumbnails on title and name pages are not changed.

alternatives.title: Edit the image address
alternatives.body: An image at `https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/<id>._V1_QL75_UX190_.jpg` is the original at `https://m.media-amazon.com/images/M/<id>._V1_.jpg`.

check.expect: (() => { const img = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="media-viewer"] img')].find((i) => i.checkVisibility() && i.getBoundingClientRect().width > 200); const a = document.querySelector('a.usermods-fullsize'); if (!img || !a || !a.checkVisibility()) return false; const base = (img.currentSrc || img.src).split('.').slice(0, -1).join('.').replace(/\._V1_.*$/, ''); return a.href === base + '._V1_.jpg' && a.target === '_blank'; })()
check.intact: (() => { const img = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="media-viewer"] img')].find((i) => i.checkVisibility() && i.getBoundingClientRect().width > 400); const bar = document.querySelector('[data-testid="action-bar"]'); return !!img && !!bar && bar.checkVisibility(); })()
